page.text:
Subgroups describe pieces of a group; quotient groups compress pieces
that are indistinguishable at a chosen scale. Group actions take the
complementary viewpoint: they represent abstract group elements as
symmetries of a set. Kernels, normal subgroups, orbits, and stabilizers
connect these constructions.
